question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 2 **
solution:
The correct answer is "**depressed**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **depressed: **(of a person) in a state of unhappiness or despondency.
 
• **devoted: **give all or most of one's time or resources to (a person or activity).
 
• **deceived: **deliberately cause (someone) to believe something that is not true, especially for personal gain.
 
• **delighted: **feeling or showing great pleasure.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**depressed" **is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• The speaker is describing his feelings after leaving the habit of watching television.
 
• When we are addicted to something and withdraw from that activity, we tend to feel dejected or **depressed**.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

The complete passage is: *I decided to stay away from television (1) for a whole year. After a week, I started feeling (2) depressed. But, my friend Bess cheered me up. She (3) encouraged me every day and would take me places. It was (4) unbelievable how much fun we had without TV. My life had become more (5) exciting without the good old idiot box. *
